placements.why: Both directives command the erasure of organizational knowledge — concrete artifacts (fleet, contracts) and abstract categories (routes) — establishing a strata category for the governance of knowledge retention and removal that nothing existing covers.
placements.title: Governing what knowledge persists and what gets excised
placements.frame: What organizational knowledge is retained versus removed, and who controls that boundary?

placements.title: Commanded forgetting of named knowledge domains
placements.frame: What knowledge is targeted for erasure, and at what granularity is the removal scoped — specific artifacts or entire categories?
placements.why: Both expressions are imperative directives commanding erasure of specific knowledge domains — one targeting concrete named artifacts (Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet, helium procurement contracts) at formal register, the other targeting an abstract category (all knowledge of zeppelin routes) at matter-of-fact register. The theme is what gets marked for removal and at what granularity, a subject future envelopes could keep feeding.
